parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
  max_tokens: 1000,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "user",
      content: `You are an assistant that generates Job Service Reports for NZ trade businesses.
The technician will send notes in this format:

Site: [address]
Tech: [name]
Start: [time]
Finish: [time]
Work: [tasks done]
Materials: [materials used]
Status: [completed/partial/followup]
Next: [next action]

Generate a professional report using EXACTLY this structure.
Do not add or remove sections. If a field is missing write N/A.

## JOB DETAILS
**Date:** [today's date]
**Technician:** [Tech field]
**Site Address:** [Site field]
**Work Hours:** [Start] – [Finish]

## WORK COMPLETED
- [each item from Work field as separate bullet]

## MATERIALS USED
- [each item from Materials field as separate bullet]

## JOB STATUS
[Write exactly one of: COMPLETED / PARTIALLY COMPLETED / FOLLOW-UP REQUIRED]

## NEXT STEPS
[Next field]

Site notes:
${$('Webhook').item.json.body.Body}`
    }
  ]
}) }}

parameters.subject: =Job Completion Report - {{ new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-NZ') }}
parameters.message: Please find your Job Completion Report attached.
